test_clip_faces: test the clip_faces function to clip mesh triangles against a frustum clipping plane
test_convert_clipped_rasterization: test convert_clipped_rasterization_to_original_faces to map clipped rasterization outputs back to original mesh faces
test_rasterize_clipped_mesh: test rasterizing a clipped mesh using _RasterizeFaceVerts with neighbor indices and barycentric coordinates
test_mesh_renderer_clipping: test MeshRenderer with RasterizationSettings z_clip_value to render meshes when the camera is inside the mesh
test_mesh_outside_frustum: test rendering a torus mesh completely outside the view frustum with cull_to_frustum enabled
